rows.en:
Goro Watari… You are a superior mutant.

Live by pledging your loyalty to the Neo-Humans, or defy us and die… The path you choose is one or the other! Which will it be, banbaaa?
Don't make me laugh! Loyalty to the Neo-Humans? Here's my answer!

Ba-ra, barabarabara, Banbaaa!

Itsutsu Banbara has fallen… but there are countless Neo-Humans. Remember that well! Goro Watari, [VAR6]!

Wait!!

He vanished…

But I won! I defeated one of the Neo-Humans… Itsutsu Banbara!

The Neo-Human Empire, out to destroy humanity… I won't forgive them! As long as I have life in me, I'll fight them!

Hey, Goro… What's up? Did something happen? Oyassan's in a bad mood!

Hm? What's that?

Um… Goro… Is something wrong? Mr. Tachibana's in a bad mood…

Huh? What's that?
…!? What's this?
Goro… This car is the Raijingo!
The Raijingo?
It's a present from Captain Saller. It's your car, Goro.
My car?
Starting today, you're a member of the Boys' League too.
Why boys, [HERO2]?

Hmm… Probably because it's easier to draw out dormant psychic powers in childhood!

And the biggest reason is probably that only a child's pure heart can use psychic powers for the sake of justice…
The reason people come to sneer at justice as they grow up…
…is that they learn that evil leads to pleasure!
The temptation of pleasure makes the heart's defenses for what's right crumble.
The Neo-Human Empire gathers only adults because that kind of wicked heart is easier to control.
I see… Humans are sad creatures, aren't they?
Not entirely… There are A-D-U-L-T-S like us, too.
Why boys, I wonder? [HERO2]?

Hmm… Probably because it's easier to draw out dormant psychic powers in childhood…

Besides… only a child's pure heart can use psychic powers for the sake of justice, right?
So the temptation of pleasure makes the heart's defenses for what's right crumble.
I see… Humans are kind of sad, huh?
Not entirely… There are A-D-U-L-T-S like us, too!
Goro Watari… [VAR6], huh. A threat to the Neo-Human Empire… and to us, a comrade we can count on.
Hey, you lot! What are you doing hanging around in front of the shop all this time! Come on, inside, inside!
His name was Goro Watari… A mighty mutant of justice had been born.
Paired with Raijingo, the all-purpose air-and-land vehicle, [VAR6], who transforms in two stages to gain limitless psychic power, has nothing to fear.
Fight on until the day you crush the ambitions of the Neo-Humans… Warrior of freedom, [VAR6]!!
Nngh… Takeshi Hongo… no, you Kamen Riders! Just you wait! Hoah, hoah, hoah…
Uoooh… Ngh… I'll let you off for today! You'll pay for this!!

Ba-ra, barabarabara, Banbaaa!

Itsutsu Banbara! Turn the city of Tokyo into ruins. And then… build the world of the Neo-Human Empire.

Are you awake now, Goro Watari…?

I am Captain Saller of the Boys' League.

The Neo-Humans intend to kill humans or control them at will, and build an empire of Neo-Humans alone…
Neo-Humans? I heard that word from that monster…
The Neo-Humans have gathered evil mutants. I formed this League with mutants untainted by the evil of the world.
Mutants?

Mutants are psychics… in other words, humans with superior abilities.

And we must fight to protect humanity from the Neo-Humans.

The Neo-Humans…

I'll fight them!!
Goro…
Captain Saller! Teach me the power to fight!! I won't forgive the Neo-Humans!
Mm… You will be reborn as a warrior of freedom who fights for justice.
Ugh…

Endure it, Goro…

Only by enduring this can you, through your own training afterward, become a mutant with psychic powers!
Waaaaagh…
Defeat Itsutsu Banbara!
Seize the laboratory and rescue Dr. Yuri!
Defeat all Phantom Soldiers! Also, seize the laboratory and rescue Dr. Yuri!
Defeat Itsutsu Banbara and all Phantom Soldiers!
Defeat Itsutsu Banbara, the Phantom Soldiers, Executive Monster Spider Man and all Shocker Combatants!
None
Goro Watari is defeated
[HERO2], what have you been watching so intently?

Hm? …Oh, it's a soccer broadcast.

Right, you wouldn't know. This is one of the most popular sports on Earth… I played it myself back in school.
Is that so…
Watching something like this really makes it sink in that I'm back on Earth…
…Oh? There's something like a cloud on the screen?
Hm? That's weird. The picture suddenly cut out. Just when it was getting good…
[HERO2], you've been glued to that for a while. Is the TV fun?
Yeah, it kills time.
Oh, this… is soccer, right?

What, you're interested? This is the second match of the TDF Cup.

So… which team are you rooting for?

Um, well, I'm……

Ah, look, [HERO2]! There's a weird cloud…
Hm… a cloud?
Not outside, in the TV!! Ah, it's gone…
What's wrong, is it broken? Hm… that's odd for a breakdown. The other channels come in fine.
It bugs me… that weird thing that showed up right before it cut out… Something looked wrong.
Ah, Boss! It doesn't look like it's broken. Something weird showed up on screen for a second just now…
Something weird?
…I don't think it was just a dark cloud. To me, it seemed like some sort of living thing… though I can't tell what it really is…
A kaiju… maybe?
BF, led by the alien invader Emperor Guillotine, used the electric kaiju Sparky to take the players and supporters of the pro soccer league hostage.
BF had two demands… The first was to ban the deployment of the giant super-weapon Giant Robo, belonging to their archenemy, the international secret police organization, the Unicorn Agency.
And the second was to hand over all of Japan as a base for BF.
In response to these demands, the Defense Director personally negotiated with BF and won a 24-hour grace period…

Did you hear that, you lot?

24 hours! If the hostages are rescued within 24 hours, Giant Robo can be deployed.
Oyassan… What's this Giant Robo?

Well, this is just what I heard too…

Apparently it's the trump card of Unicorn's Japan Branch, which is fighting the secret society BF, and it's a giant humanoid robot.

They say a boy from Unicorn's Japan Branch controls it remotely.

A boy?

Still, a giant robot of justice… That sounds like something we can count on.

Mm…

But right now, like we heard on the news, it's been banned from deploying because BF has taken hostages.

So that's where you lot come in!
